provenance.label: HAND-AUTHORED. NOT A RECORDING.
provenance.note: Written by hand from the published KSeF OpenAPI contract. No request was ever sent to api-test.ksef.mf.gov.pl, or to any other host, to produce this file. The field names and types come from the contract; every value is invented.
invented: errors[0].code: the numeric code is invented. The contract types ApiError.code as int32 and requires it, but does not publish the code list, so no value here should be read as a real KSeF error code.
detail, description, details: invented Polish text standing in for the real messages
traceId: W3C traceparent shape; instance: the request path
The rule being violated is real: the contract caps dateRange at 100 days.
